direct_controls.statistics_sequence: 24 scalars/frame: original 10 common-state/resource statistics; relative-height range and std; three ground-state fractions; two mean motion channels, mean absolute vertical motion and motion-known fraction; horizontal and absolute-height pair mean/max; pair-known indicator. Zero-fill undefined numeric summaries, retain indicators. Flatten five frames. Source-training-only coordinate standardization (std floored at 1e-6), mean squared vector distance.
direct_controls.full_input_matching: Min over 120 consistent five-frame player assignments of the equal mean of five squared-error blocks: 15 masked node fields; node feature-validity bits; three unordered-pair fields; unordered pair-validity bits; survival bits. Fixed v0.3 scales only; no fitted normalization. Invalid own-side observations are zero-filled with explicit mask blocks.
direct_controls.library: Same source-training windows for all methods; no query series; same-map cross-series and cross-map retrieval reported separately; stable candidate index breaks ties.
direct_controls.neural_distance: Mean squared distance between 64-dimensional embeddings; no test normalization or reranking.
direct_controls.status: Rules frozen here before matrix test outputs; direct-control ranking implementation belongs to E3-E4.

limits: Reconstruction loss is not tactical relevance or real-world coaching benefit.

Seeds averaged within each window; windows averaged within series; series weighted equally.
